notes.title: P-BOT - Patch Notes! Version 1.1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36467246/74426ff837e1c5caf6ff7b4699d77ed55efafa56.png[/img]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Delivery Mode[/h2][list][*] Added an conveyor belt that boosts the player
[/list]
[h2]Fly Mode[/h2][list][*] Added firework cannons that shoot fireworks into the air
[/list]
[h2]Climb Mode[/h2][list][*] Added moving elevators
[*] Added industrial coolers
[*] Added conveyor belts that move the player
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[h2]Delivery Mode[/h2][list][*] Removed the wall jumps
[/list]

notes.title: P-BOT - Patch Notes! Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36467246/8686ed2ee4a280b14752ad0827465717de1cbb10.png[/img]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Fly Mode[/h2][list][*] Added obstacle lasers that move up and down
[/list]
[h2]Climb Mode[/h2][list][*] Added a piston obstacle that pushes the player of the building
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[h2]Fly Mode[/h2][list][*] Made the factory entrance and exit bigger
[/list]
[h2]Climb Mode[/h2][list][*] Changed the blockade visual to a window cleaning rig
[/list]
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[h2]General[/h2][list][*]Fixed a bug where the leaderboard images didn't load correctly
[/list]
[h2]Climb Mode[/h2][list][*]Fixed a bug where the camera wouldn't rotate correctly
[/list]

notes.title: P-BOT - Patch Notes! Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36467246/d69e2061b82f57f49dc419d9cff6b5286c97e724.png[/img]
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Climb Mode[/h2][list][*] The player can now rotate the camera whilst climbing
[*] Added obstacle planes that fly close to the building
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[h2]Fly Mode[/h2][list][*]Fixed a bug where the player could clip through the train station floor
[/list]

notes.title: New game mode
notes.content: We have added a new gamemode to P-BOT called climb mode! In this gamemode you climb a tower while dodging obstacles. It's still a work in progress, and we're going to add a lot more to it.

notes.title: P-BOT Discord server
notes.content:
Do you have any feedback you'd like to share? Do you want to get involved with the development of the game? Do you want to know what we're currently up to? Then you can join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/M8cC2qj

Here we discuss the current state of the game. We are highly involved with the community and we take your suggestions seriously. We're always open for feedback.
